name: Kansai Paint Co., Ltd.
summary: Kansai Paint Co., Ltd. makes and supplies paints and coatings worldwide, with a presence in Japan, India, the rest of Asia, Africa, Europe and elsewhere. Its products include decorative and protective architectural finishes, automotive paints for production and repair, and industrial coatings. It also carries out painting contracts and offers color scheme development services. Dating from 1918, it has its headquarters in Osaka, Japan.
